claim_level: Heuristic search priority; source integrity and admission findings require verification
question: Does an additional public study supply human adult-origin primary-cell RNA measurements and a directly measured cellular functional phenotype with an authoritative culture and collection-context link?
registration_timing: After bibliographic discovery of the four candidates, before detailed source-table inspection or any new outcome calculation. This is a bounded source screen, not a prospective biological experiment or outcome-blind protocol.

candidate_roster.role: Longitudinal aging and physiology comparator; intervention rejuvenation is a separate question
Chemical reprogramming and compartmentalization reporter; endpoint validity and culture linkage require inspection
Chemical reprogramming; human cellular readouts must be separated from worm functional and lifespan outcomes
Species and endpoint eligibility check; transcriptomic rejuvenation alone does not supply measured human function

existing_candidates: Keep the eight-study linked-function-admission-2026-10-31 registry and all original Gill contracts/results unchanged. A new comparator answers a separately specified question.
required_inputs: Explicit species, adult donor age/origin, primary versus pluripotent-derived status and cell type
Reusable processed RNA measurements with original sample identifiers and source provenance
Numerical measured functional observations with units, culture identifiers and replicate meaning
Authoritative same-parent aliquot or explicitly matched sibling-culture link with donor, experiment, treatment, collection date/passage and relevant assay context
admission_rules: Donor-only, treatment-only, row-order and nearest-date joins are insufficient for a paired culture analysis.
Destructive assays imply parent/sibling-culture scope, not same-cell continuity.
Repeated time points and wells do not create independent donors.

A nuclear-localization reporter, basal respiration, ATP abundance, proliferation or a senescence marker supports only its explicitly named readout; none independently establishes tissue restoration or rejuvenation.
A physiological calibration dataset can qualify for a separately frozen comparator without becoming a partial-reprogramming intervention or a replacement for Gill's clock/migration inputs.
Conflicting species, age, dose, treatment or collection context defers the join.
Figure digitization, newly trained clocks and imputed sample mappings are outside this screen.
outcome_policy: Source acquisition, sample-link auditing and coverage counts only. A qualifying dataset receives a source-bound follow-on analysis specification before any molecular/function effect or association is calculated.
stop_rule: Inspect at most these four additional studies and their directly linked primary deposits. Stop at one source-complete candidate or completion of the roster. Preserve exclusions and access failures; do not extend the search indefinitely.
limits: No new efficacy, safety, lineage retention, persistence or clinical conclusion
No new wet-lab work, paid compute, mailbox review or message send
Phase 483 and existing support_only/insufficient_signal gates remain unchanged
Original investigators retain experimental and biological-discovery credit
